metadata.title: Abundance anomalies in red giants with possible extragalactic origins unveiled by APOGEE-2

notes: No star meets the eligibility criteria. The paper studies five APOGEE stars: 2M17535944+4708092, 2M12155306+1431114, 2M16062302-1126161, 2M17534571-2949362, and 2M17180311-2750124 (T:p2-b4; I:p2-b4; Fig. 1, I:p4-b0). The first two are only suggested to have possible extragalactic origins/outer-halo birth and have Zmax > 10 kpc (T:p2-b3; T:p2-b6); this is neither a present-day Galactic-unbound claim nor an established escape criterion. The other three are placed in the inner stellar halo, and the sole “unbound stars” wording (T:p1-b2) occurs in a speculative migration/resonant-trapping history, not as a retained current unbound status; the conclusion instead calls them kinematically consistent with the inner stellar halo (T:p2-b6). The earlier-work discussion (T:p1-b5) likewise describes only extragalactic-origin speculation, not prior Galactic-unbound candidacy, so follow_up is not supported.
